items.title: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) Stock Looks Above Fair Value On Cash Flow
items.summary: Cadence Design Systems has seen its share price move around over the years, and the stock has recently given back some ground after earlier gains. That sets up a straightforward question for investors who care about fundamentals, which is whether the current US$294.89 price is supported by the cash the business is expected to generate. items.summary: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) just reported third quarter 2026 results, raised its full year revenue and earnings outlook, and outlined a larger share repurchase plan focused on free cash flow.
